summary:
## Goal
Add a CSV importer for vendor credits; SQLAlchemy 2.0 remains paused. Finish the in-progress invoice pagination work.

## Constraints and rules
Pin licensing tools exactly. Rebase onto `origin/main` and squash at 12 commits or when review-ready. Run Kafka repartition steps separately and in order. Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is obsolete.

## Key decisions and facts
Invoice listing now uses a paginated envelope: `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`; defaults are 20 items with `limit` constrained to 1–100 and offset to nonnegative. Billing uses Decimal-safe discounts, timezone-aware timestamps, and invoice-ID-guarded idempotency completion.

## Ruled out
SQLAlchemy upgrade; retrying all HTTP errors; per-invoice embeddings; `httpx` 0.23.

## Progress
Invoice API tests pass (9), pagination tests pass (3), integration tests pass (31), and lint/format checks pass. Idempotency race fix was committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`. Credit-after-refund still reports `90.00` vs `87.50`.

## Next steps
Review/commit pagination changes, inspect vendor-credit CSV format, implement importer/tests, and investigate credit/refund ordering.

## Goal
Upgrade SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 across ledgerly models and optimize search rebuild performance.

## Constraints and rules
Pin licensing tools exactly in `requirements/license-tools.txt`. At 12 commits or when review-ready, rebase onto `origin/main` and squash to one commit. Run Kafka repartition steps separately and in order.

## Key decisions and facts
Search rebuilds are tenant-scoped, use shared/concurrent embeddings (8 workers, chunks of 100), and bulk-upsert vectors. Migration 0042 adds unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` indexing. CSV output explicitly uses UTF-8. Kafka `orders.v1` has 6 partitions, replication factor 3. Sandbox payments URL: `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev`.

## Ruled out
Retrying all HTTP errors; 4xx is non-retryable. Per-invoice embedding is too slow. Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 broke the Stripe client.

## Progress
Full suite passed: 186 passed, 3 skipped. Exporter suite: 24 passed; CSV encoding tests pass 8/8. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. 10k search benchmark: 2.41s median vs 16.73s. Invoice annotations partially added; mypy found one error because `build_invoice_lines` returns a generator but is annotated `list[LineItem]`.

## Next steps
Fix the `build_invoice_lines` annotation/implementation mismatch, complete remaining billing annotations, run mypy and full tests/formatting, then address SQLAlchemy 2.0 compatibility and remaining Kafka steps individually.
